diagnosis.effect: The retained production video was treated as missing and the evaluator attempted to read an undefined asset id before creating an evaluation job.
supportingEvidence: The durable commercial job reached quality after generation and composition.
Production Ark storage contains successful image and video jobs for the attempt but no quality evaluation Ark job.
retainCommercialArtifact returns a manifest whose shot binding is metadata.shotId.

localFix.behavior: Resolve a retained video by either the legacy flat shotId fixture shape or the production metadata.shotId manifest shape.
localFix.regression: quality inspector reads the shot binding from a retained production asset manifest

decision: Do not replay the failed paid attempt. Build and qualify a new immutable candidate containing the fix before any separately necessary production acceptance action.
